summary: Provides comprehensive infrastructure components and core domain logic, encompassing database management, file system operations, configuration, logging, process execution, and specialized data processing utilities.
responsibilities: Provide infrastructure utilities for file I/O, archives, hashing, streams, CSV parsing, and process execution
Manage database connections, persistence, and ORM mapping
Handle configuration loading and logging infrastructure
Implement core domain logic including business calendars and parameter access
relationships: The gyomu package encapsulates core domain logic and services supporting the infrastructure package.
design_decisions: Organizes infrastructure and domain logic into modular subcomponents across specialized domains
Leverages external frameworks such as SQLAlchemy and Pydantic for data handling and persistence
